text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oof… The sun is so bright. It's making me dizzy.
choice_data_list: Are you feeling under the weather?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: No… It's just that there's a child staying at my parents' place right now…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: They keep waking up in the middle of the night and won't go to sleep until they talk to me for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm getting multiple phone calls every night…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Mnnh… I feel like I might pass out on the spot…
